name: unnoticed-display-length

finding.title: A long single-sentence description now shows in full, past the visible budget
finding.description: When the first sentence alone is longer than `room`, `splitLead` returns a cut lead and `rest` set to the whole description. If that description is one sentence, `rest.split(...)` has length 1 and holds no newline, so `folds` is false. `formatFindingComment` then prints `description.trim()` uncut, so a 2000-character description shows in full instead of a cut lead plus a `Details` fold, past the 700-character `MAX_VISIBLE_COMMENT` budget. The text shown is the whole description, complete and correct, so it misleads no one. Only a description that is a single sentence longer than `room` takes this path, and the comment is then longer on screen than the budget aims for.
finding.suggestedFix: Fold whenever `splitLead` cut the lead, for example with a `truncated` flag it returns. Show `description.trim()` only when `rest` is one sentence and the total still fits `room`.
